name: Mealie
description: Recipe manager and meal planner that imports recipes from any site

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything: the SQLite database, recipe images, backups and the secret keys Mealie makes on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Mealie web UI and API, published on host as 6767

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: The address you open Mealie at, used for links in emails and shared recipes. Change localhost to your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6767, for working links.

variables.name: ALLOW_SIGNUP
variables.description: false means only people you invite can make an account. Set it to true to let anyone sign up on the sign-in page.

variables.name: MEALIE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the first admin, changeme@example.com. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used until you change it in Mealie.
